description.zh_cn: 命中时有 16% 概率分裂至最多两个附近目标，造成 35% 伤害。
description.en: Hits have a 16% chance to split to up to two nearby targets for 35% damage.

description.zh_cn: 爆炸与区域武器范围 +30%，伤害 -8%。
description.en: Explosion and zone weapons gain 30% area but deal 8% less damage.

description.zh_cn: 武器命中会施加 12% 减速，持续 1.4 秒。
description.en: Weapon hits apply a 12% slow for 1.4 seconds.

description.zh_cn: 每第 7 次武器施放会以 45% 强度回响一次。
description.en: Every seventh weapon cast echoes at 45% strength.

description.zh_cn: 暴击击杀有 8% 概率获得 1 金币，每秒最多触发 3 次。
description.en: Critical kills have an 8% chance to grant 1 gold, up to three times per second.

description.zh_cn: 连续拾取星光会累积短暂的磁力层数。
description.en: Collecting starlight builds temporary magnet stacks.

description.zh_cn: 最大生命 -20%；满生命时伤害 +40%。
description.en: Maximum health -20%; damage +40% while at full health.

description.zh_cn: 抵挡下一次命中，消耗后 45 秒恢复。
description.en: Blocks the next hit and recharges after 45 seconds.

description.zh_cn: 对精英与首领伤害 +28%，普通敌人伤害 -5%；首领宝箱金币 +20%。
description.en: Deal 28% more damage to elites and bosses, 5% less to normal enemies, and gain 20% more boss-chest gold.

description.zh_cn: 区域持续伤害触发间隔 -18%，持续时间 -10%。
description.en: Zone damage ticks 18% faster but lasts 10% less time.

description.zh_cn: 弹体速度加成会转化为额外伤害，最高 +24%。
description.en: Projectile-speed bonuses convert into damage, up to +24%.

description.zh_cn: 当前等级最低的武器数量 +1。
description.en: Your lowest-level weapon gains +1 quantity.
